changes: Run Shell and SQLite blocks inline with native confirmation, results beneath the block, and runnable Guide examples.
Add Reading Focus, a responsive Library, and easier access to reading and editing controls in narrow windows.
Improve Arabic and mixed-direction typography with separate interface and document fonts.
Show Markdown in the folder tree, hide unavailable recent files and bookmarks, and clear recent history while keeping bookmarks.
Add tab close actions, move manual updates to Settings About, and refresh the indigo branding.
Reclaim document space with a shared macOS title/tab row, one contextual document toolbar, on-demand Format/More controls and full-height side-by-side Split at narrow window sizes.
